summary: Iter140 — FINAL Arcane Hearth 3D pre-founder verification. BACKEND: 8/8 pytest GREEN — re-ran iter139 regression suite (/app/backend/tests/test_iter139_wkq_arcane_v1.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter140.xml). Coverage: registry 3 active keys (level_index 0/1/2, level_no 1/3/5), award idempotency across all 3 levels + 404 on invalid, fire-info enabled 50/250 economy exact, score submit stage+finale grants idempotent via gfp:* keys; test cleanup wipes throwaway realm-keys + founder gfp fire grants + refunds pool as required by review request. FRONTEND E2E (stealth founder, /games?play=wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1, 14s+ GLB warmup): (a) [data-testid=three-runtime] + [data-testid=three-canvas-mount] mount, WebGL renderer live. (b) HUD reads EXACTLY 'Level 1/3 · 🥕 0/3 · 🪙 0 · 💎 0 · ⭐ 0' — spec match. (c) Quest msg reads EXACTLY 'Sky Harbor Kitchens — speak with the chef!' — spec match. (d) window.__OR3D_ASSETS exposes 16 slots — includes ALL 10 mandated Meshy GLB slots: player_model, model_npc, model_guardian, model_boss, model_station, model_hazard, model_key, model_portal, model_ingredient, model_env_kit — plus 6 texture slots (arc_ground/wall_l1/l3/l5). (e) window.__OR3D_TEXDBG reports both L1 media images 'loaded' (/api/media/images/56a3...png ground + /api/media/images/2738...png wall). (f) performance.getEntriesByType('resource') shows 8 .glb fetches (all HTTP 200 via R2 CDN 307-redirect) + Draco decoder loaded from gstatic (draco_wasm_wrapper.js + draco_decoder.wasm) — exactly matches spec expectation. (g) Screenshot .screenshots/iter140_L1.png (also /app/test_reports/iter140_L1.png) shows: rich cobblestone-textured flagstone ground, textured tiled wall/counter geometry, bright blue L1 sky (~#7fc4e8), Maeve 3D character (auburn braid figure) at spawn — NOT a green capsule, and an additional green Meshy character model (chef NPC or brazier hazard) visible north of Maeve — genuine 3D Meshy GLB integration CONFIRMED. (h) Fullscreen toggle [data-testid=three-fullscreen-toggle] adds document.body.className 'or3d-css-fs' — verified. (i) HUD + quest msg both visible in portrait 390x844 AND landscape 844x390 viewports — no stretching/clipping. (j) Uncaught console errors on load+play = 0 game errors; only 8 pre-existing 401s on unrelated anon endpoints (acceptable per review spec). REGRESSION: /games?play=wkq-skybound-chef-v2 title screen renders — 'World Kitchen Quest: Skybound Chef' banner + description + 'TAP OR PRESS ANY KEY TO START' + fire-info banner '🔥 Fire Power rewards — server-verified · Finish +10,000 (once per player)' + leaderboard visible; 0 additional console errors. NOT PROVEN via playwright (identical documented limitation as iter139, NOT a product bug): full L1 quest chain talk→gather→fight→key→portal end-to-end. Root cause is now clearly identified as headless Chromium requestAnimationFrame throttling — with __OR3D_TP-style teleport hook absent, dispatched keydown+held keys advance player.position only ~0.35 units per 2s (vs expected 7 u/s at 60fps), because RAF ticks at ~1Hz in headless off-viewport windows. All quest-loop primitives are implemented and reviewed intact in ThreeRuntime.jsx L189-245 and questLevel.js attachModel L28-51.
action_items: OPTIONAL (nice-to-have, not blocking): expose window.__OR3D_TP(x,z) or window.__OR3D_SET_KEY(k,v) debug hook so future playwright regressions can drive the full quest chain without RAF-throttling limits. Backend award+score idempotency is already fully proven server-side; this only closes the last E2E automation gap.
OPTIONAL: consider softening L1 spawn/wall layout so straight w-hold reaches NPC — Level 1 is the tutorial and the current east-detour past x=-9.5 (wall [-14,4,8,2]) is subtle.
critical_code_review_comments: questLevel.js attachModel (L28-51) correctly clones the loaded GLB scene per anchor, normalizes size via Box3, offsets to grounded yBase, applies optional yaw + emissive override, and importantly sets anchor.material.visible=false so the greybox primitive underneath disappears once the Meshy model attaches — clean fallback behaviour if the GLB fetch fails (primitive stays visible).

makeGLTFLoader() + loadGLB() (L12-24) uses a module-scoped Promise cache keyed by URL so identical GLBs (e.g., model_hazard used at multiple accent_lights) are downloaded once and re-cloned — correct memory & bandwidth pattern.

ThreeRuntime.jsx (L60-73) swaps the player capsule for Maeve GLB with animation-mixer hookup — mixer.update(dt) only ticks when input magnitude>0.05 (L170), correctly freezing walk animation when idle, no crash on ended animation.
guardian model_boss vs model_guardian selected via lvl.boss flag (questLevel.js L131) — matches spec.levels_3d[L5].boss=true wiring; boss scale bumped to 3.0 vs guardian 2.2.
Realm-keys registry + award idempotency + fire-info economy 50/250 + stage/finale grant idempotency all remain proven server-side by iter139 tests re-run in iter140 (100% pass).

GLB assets served via /api/media/... with 307-redirect to R2 storage — verified 8/8 HTTP 200 resource entries in browser performance timeline; Draco decoder loaded from https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/ as configured in questLevel.js L11.

ThreeRuntime.jsx L9 imports GLTFLoader directly but never uses it (makeGLTFLoader is the only user) — trivial dead import, not a defect. Suggest removing the top-level import for cleanliness in a future pass.

Full L1 quest chain end-to-end not proven (same iter139-documented headless RAF throttling limit, NOT a product bug).
